name: botbuilders-portal
description: BotBuilders client-portal (ClientClub) Custom JS/CSS, versioned and served from jsDelivr

scripts.version: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/check.mjs && git add -A
scripts.release: npm version patch -m "release v%s" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "release v%s" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "release v%s" && git push --follow-tags
